title: Presentation Content Centering
description: All presentation content must be centered horizontally and vertically. Projektetage intro currently starts at the top because text dispositions incorrectly use the positioned canvas layout.
summary:
Fixed presentation content not being vertically centered on intro/flow slides.

Root cause: `ArrangementSection` treated any text disposition as "positioned", wrapping intro slides in a full-height `presentation-arrangement-canvas`. Content stacked from the top of that canvas instead of using reveal.js `center: true` flow centering.

Fix: only use the positioned canvas when a disposition has explicit `position` or `split` (matching the figure-split plan). Added renderer test asserting intro slides have no canvas. Verified live on projektetage :6050 — title slide centered horizontally and vertically. All 14 renderer tests pass.
